fusions.name: Clamped Fast
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 3 tiles at a target at or below 25% health and locks your horns on it for 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Riverbank Thrash
fusions.desc: Rolls with your horns down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunning Rock
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Waiting Jaw
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 30% more critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
